metadata.description: Comprehensive Minecraft feature categorization into Core, Content, and Utility categories

core.description: Essential systems required for basic Minecraft functionality

components.name: Cave Generation
components.description: Advanced cave algorithms with hydrology awareness
components.notes: Hydrology-aware with regional main caves, worm-based algorithms, and stability systems

components.name: River Generation
components.description: Flow-aware river generation with pressure balancing
components.notes: Flow-aware with pressure balancing, seam stitching, and confluence boosting

components.description: Hydrology-driven lake generation with basin formation
components.notes: Hydrology-driven with basin formation, flow seepage, and shoreline complexity
